findings.title: Ticket-card bulk selection nests a checkbox and a status button inside a Link, so ticking a ticket also navigates
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: TicketCard is a div; only the subject is a Link, the select checkbox sits outside any anchor, and the status pill is a button (apps/web/components/admin/AdminTicketCenterClient.tsx:160-241). The interactive a11y suite exercises the bulk bar and status filter (apps/web/e2e/a11y.spec.ts:203-218).

findings.title: Inline async action errors are not announced by assistive tech in ~44 components, contradicting the documented convention
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: a fresh scan of 557 app/components tsx files finds no error-state component with an inline error var and no role=alert/status/aria-live (only the route error boundaries were excluded); every previously cited call site uses role=alert (DmarcAnalyzeForm.tsx:93, CreateRoleForm.tsx:106, RecordDetail.tsx:166,204, UploadForm.tsx:64,72, PortalTriageClient.tsx:98, CameraCalculatorClient.tsx:148, QbrGenerateForm.tsx:82, ProposalForm.tsx:83, OrganizationOnboardingWizard.tsx:189).

findings.title: Several dialogs have no max-height or internal scroll, so tall forms are clipped on small viewports
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: the shared Dialog panel is max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto (packages/ui/src/components/Dialog.tsx:116) and the ad-hoc modals are migrated (PromoForm.tsx, CategoryForm.tsx, SupportCenterClient.tsx, documents/CreateDocumentModal.tsx). A repo scan finds 0 modal dialogs without max-h/overflow; the only matches are the fixed banners/toasts (OfflineIndicator, StickyMobileCta, ConsentBanner). mobile.spec.ts:302-340 asserts the promotion/category dialogs scroll.

findings.title: 89 of 319 pages have no page-specific title (79 dynamic detail pages + 10 static), so browser and AT titles are generic
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: 330 page.tsx scanned; 0 have neither metadata nor generateMetadata nor an explicit <title>. Dynamic detail routes use generateMetadata (e.g. admin/tickets/[ticketId]/page.tsx:27, portal/support/[ticketId]/page.tsx:53, admin/assets/[id]/page.tsx:13) and the six client auth pages render <title>.

findings.title: @mct/ui primitives are largely bypassed: 6 files import Button, 1 uses Input/Dialog/Badge, while the app hand-rolls 234 raw cyber-button* usages and four Chip copies
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: the four Chip copies remain gone - one shared Chip in packages/ui (Chip.tsx:1-36) imported by the admin lists - and docs/WEB_UI_CONVENTIONS.md:90-91 still names @mct/ui as the standard. Remaining: adoption is still shallow - 14 tsx files import @mct/ui Button vs 265 raw cyber-button* occurrences (88 cyber-button + 174 cyber-button-secondary + 2 sm + 1 danger) and there is no lint/regex guard against new raw cyber-* controls, so the drift can return.

findings.title: Four Chip copies render a glyph-only 'x' remove button with a sub-24px target size
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: the shared Chip renders a 24x24 remove button (h-6 w-6, -my-1 -mr-1) with aria-label 'Remove <label>' and aria-hidden glyph (packages/ui/src/components/Chip.tsx:24-36); the four local copies were deleted.

findings.title: Theme is documented dark-only but ships dead light/system code paths (CSS variables, ThemeProvider, Storybook toolbar)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: use-theme.tsx is a fixed dark provider with no light/system branch (packages/ui/src/hooks/use-theme.tsx:6-30), styles.css has no light block or prefers-color-scheme branch, .storybook/preview.tsx has only the dark background, and docs/WEB_UI_CONVENTIONS.md:98-100 matches.

findings.title: Sidebar group toggles declare aria-haspopup='true' for a popup that is a link list, not a menu
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: no aria-haspopup remains in the sidebar components or the app (grep 0 matches outside tests that assert its absence); aria-expanded/aria-controls and keyboard handling remain.

findings.title: Notification bell and store drawer toggles omit aria-expanded
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: NotificationBell.tsx:285 sets aria-expanded={open}; components/store/StoreLayoutShell.tsx:36 and components/layout/SidebarShell.tsx:80 set aria-expanded={drawerOpen}; the bell and drawers close on Escape.

findings.title: Color-token drift: 66 files hardcode hex colors (80x #0A1118) and 45 arbitrary rgba card backgrounds instead of the design tokens
findings.note: REGRESSED at 6b7aa1a: commit 8f8642ab reintroduced the exact token the fix removed - `text-[#0A1118]` at apps/web/components/cab/CabMeetingsClient.tsx:225 - and the new NetworkDiagramCanvas.tsx:9-20 hardcodes 13 hex colors (NODE_COLORS + strokes). A scan of 557 tsx files now finds 8 files / 113 hardcoded 6-digit hex values (was 6 files at 7dd0402; test-accounts page accounts for 90), and arbitrary bg-[rgba(...)] stays at 0. Fix: move NODE_COLORS/edge colors to @mct/ui/tokens and replace the CabMeetingsClient literal with a token utility; add a lint rule for hex literals in tsx.

findings.title: Heading order skips a level on the store import/export page
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: the five section headings on the store import/export page are h2 under AdminPageShell's h1 (ImportExportClient.tsx:168,193,220,239,259). Residual heading-order skips on other pages are filed as new UX-P3-012.

findings.title: ScorecardsEvaluateClient renders the only programmatically unlabeled input in the app and an unannounced error
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: the input has aria-label='Organization ID (optional)' and the error span has role='alert' (apps/web/app/(admin)/admin/edu-automation/scorecards/ScorecardsEvaluateClient.tsx:39,50).

findings.title: Signup form inputs lack autocomplete attributes
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: signup sets autoComplete name/email/new-password (apps/web/app/(public)/signup/page.tsx:77,96,115).

findings.title: Storybook covers only the 7 @mct/ui primitives; packages/ui has no test/lint scripts and the a11y addon runs nowhere
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: packages/ui has lint/typecheck/test/test:coverage scripts (packages/ui/package.json) and a smoke test, and 14 story files now cover the primitives plus app-level ConfirmDialog/DataErrorNote/ToastProvider/StatusPill/EmptyState/Breadcrumbs; the a11y addon is asserted per story via parameters.a11y.test:'error' (.storybook/preview.tsx:17-25) and Chromatic has no job-level continue-on-error. Residual (CI-P2-006 domain): Chromatic is still not a required check.

findings.title: Full accessibility breadth scan (68 routes) is triage-only and not a required check
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: a11y-breadth.yml calls e2e.yml with a11y_full:true and the spec fails on critical/serious violations not in apps/web/e2e/a11y-baseline.json (a11y.spec.ts:96-180; baseline is empty), and docs/CI.md:156 describes it as a scheduled gate. Remaining: the workflow is still not a required context in .github/branch-protection/main.json (8 contexts, no a11y) and the default E2E gate runs 25 of the 68 routes (a11y.spec.ts:25-47 vs 52-96).

findings.title: The a11y gate scans only initial page loads; interactive states (dialogs, drawers, filters, bulk bars) and client-fetched content are untested
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: an interactive-states describe opens the admin bulk bar, applies a status filter chip, opens the store categories drawer and the create-promotion dialog, each running axe in the open state (apps/web/e2e/a11y.spec.ts:198-240).

findings.title: Heading order still skips h1 -> h3 on at least six pages (portal dashboard, status, resources, compare, projects, client-portal)
findings.note: NEW at 6b7aa1a: the dashboard renders h1 at apps/web/app/(portal)/portal/dashboard/page.tsx:137 then h3 section headings at :176,210,245,282 with no h2; /portal/status is h1 at :36 then h3 at :69; /resources h1 at :32 then h3 at :58; /store/compare h1 at :33 then h3 at :54; /portal/projects h1 at :107 then h3 at :122; /portal/client-portal h1 at :42 then h3 at :62. WCAG 1.3.1 / heading-order best practice expects no skipped levels; screen-reader users get a misleading outline. Fix: promote the section headings to h2 (and any card titles below them to h3); add a lint/axe rule.
